Appeals against CCI decisions lie with the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT), and further appeals can be made to the Supreme Court.

items: NCLAT is the designated appellate body for CCI decisions, a frequent question in statutory regulatory frameworks.
Further appeals against NCLAT orders can only be made to the Supreme Court of India.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Appeals against decisions made by the Competition Commission of India (CCI) are directed to the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT).
The Supreme Court serves as the final authority for further appeals beyond the NCLAT.
The appellate hierarchy follows a two-tiered structure: CCI -> NCLAT -> Supreme Court.
